results.name: B. Nathaniel Bespoke (B. Nathaniel Custom Clothier)
results.notes: Re-ran the site at 390px: window.innerWidth is 390 but document.documentElement.scrollWidth is 1014 and the outer Duda container .dmInner measures exactly 768px, so the 'fixed at 768px' mobile claim is accurate - the top banner, nav and hero text are clipped in the screenshot. JSON-LD is a single WebSite block (name + url only); no LocalBusiness. Both hero 'Book Now' buttons point to /contact, which has a Name/Email/Phone/Message form, two tel: links, bnatbespoke@gmail.com and the 28 Paterson St address; copyright reads 2026. Shop category pages (e.g. /shop-mens-suits/Wedding-Clothing-Packages-c139693607) list products with no prices, so 'no pricing anywhere' holds. robots.txt is effectively empty (sitemap pointer only). Birdeye re-checked: 4.8 / 497 reviews and 'claimed by the business owner'. Extra (not in the record): Birdeye hours open at 10:00 Mon-Fri while the site says 9:00 - an NAP inconsistency. Scores gap 4 / ability 4 / ease 4 / evidence 5 stand.

results.name: Downtown Printing Center

wrong_claims.what_is_true: The /contact page does contain tel: links for (732) 246-7990 (two of them); the real gap is the home page, which has no phone number, address or CTA as text at all.

results.notes: Home page body text is only the nav line plus '(c) 2022' footer - no services, address, phone, hours, h1, meta description and 0 forms - so top issue 1 holds. LocalBusiness JSON-LD is present with 46 Paterson St, New Brunswick NJ 08901, confirming it is the only local schema in this batch. /contact form is Name / Email (required) / Message with the GoDaddy reCAPTCHA notice and no specs, quantity or upload fields. Services page is one flat four-family list (digital, offset, screen, signs). robots.txt is exactly 'User-agent: *' with no rules. Birdeye re-checked: 3.8 with 29 reviews. Minor: Birdeye lists 9:00-6:00 hours against the site's 8:30-5:30. Only correction is the auxiliary click_to_call field; top issues and opportunities hold, so scores gap 5 / ability 3 / ease 4 / evidence 5 stand.

results.name: Midlantic Property Management

wrong_claims.claim: Template branding 'The Community - It's Time to Stand Out' is still visible on the site
wrong_claims.what_is_true: Not present in the home page HTML or on the contact/proposal pages checked; the header reads 'The Community Association Specialists'. The rest of the 'abandoned site' evidence (free Weebly subdomain, '@2013. All Rights Reserved.', no h1, no meta description) is all correct.
The site has a 'Meet the President' page and the About page is signed H. James Polos, President - one named person, though no broader staff list.

results.notes: Top issues re-verified: 0 contact/quote forms on any page (the only form element is the Weebly site-search box, action /apps/search); phone '(732) 828-7200' is plain text with 0 tel: links; footer '@2013. All Rights Reserved.'; no h1 and no meta description; proposal requests still ask visitors to phone or hand-write an 11-item email. robots.txt matches the record exactly (/ajax/ and /apps/ only). Maps shows 1.6 stars, 'Claim this business', 'Add missing information' and 'Add hours' - so the listing is unclaimed as well as hourless, which strengthens not weakens top issue 4. Extra gap the record missed: the site has no viewport meta and lays out at 980px on a 390px screen, so it is not mobile-responsive. Scores gap 5 / ability 4 / ease 4 / evidence 4 stand.

results.name: MLB Tax LLC
results.notes: robots.txt reproduces exactly: ~60 whitelisted agents (incl. Googlebot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Perplexity-User), then 'User-agent: * # Disallow everyone else / Disallow: /' - PerplexityBot itself is not named. Loading https://www.mlbtaxllc.com/contact.php in Chrome returns a '403 Forbidden' page, the same 403 the record reports, while a plain HTTP request returns the full page. Raw HTML confirms the embedded Google map iframe is pinned to '1180 6th Ave, New York, NY 10036', the form is Name/E-Mail/Phone/'Best time to call'/Comments behind a securimage CAPTCHA image, the template loads ie7-js/mediaqueries-js from googlecode.com and the YUI calendar, and the footer social icons point at facebook.com / twitter.com / linkedin.com home pages. Maps search for 'MLB Tax LLC South River NJ' returns only Meky Accounting and Pinnacle Accounting - no listing for the firm, so top issue 1 holds. Titles and meta description do name 'South River, NJ Accounting Firm'. Scores gap 5 / ability 4 / ease 4 / evidence 4 stand; the 403 behaviour does add delivery risk, already flagged in the record's reason.

results.name: MS3 Corp. Architects
results.notes: Reproduced directly: Chrome returns net::ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID for https://ms3corp.com/ and https://www.ms3corp.com/ (TLS verify failure on both), http://ms3corp.com/ serves a bare InMotion Hosting placeholder ('HOSTNAME'), and http://ms3corp.com/services.html returns 404. Maps shows 'MS3 Corp. Architects, 5.0, Architect', 36 Monticello Way, (848) 218-1744, website ms3corp.com, with 'Claim this business', 'Add missing information' and 'Add hours' - unclaimed, no hours, matching all three top issues. Business looks active rather than defunct (live claimed-looking profile with rating, phone, and the firm appears in public agency professional-services listings), so 'operating' with a dead website is a fair read. Scores gap 5 / ability 3 / ease 5 / evidence 4 stand.

data_gaps: Google web search (google.com/search) is blocked by a 'unusual traffic' bot check in this browser session, so review counts that were originally sourced from Google search panels - notably Midlantic's '47 reviews' - could not be recounted; its 1.6 rating and missing-hours prompts were confirmed from the Maps place panel.

Google Maps was only readable in the limited (non-consented) view, which shows rating, category, address, phone, hours prompts and 'Claim this business' but not review counts; review-volume figures for Midlantic, NJP Associates, Menlo, Frotton, MLB Tax and MS3 rest on the original record.
MLB Tax's contact page returns HTTP 403 to Chrome, so the rendered layout and Google-map pin were checked from the raw HTML (plain HTTP response) rather than on-screen rendering.
